result:
QA-29278 is **BLOCKED**: I couldn't evaluate either assertion, so there is no partial PASS. I didn't open the browser flow for the third Thursday pair (Ralph Lauren) because dev was failing.

- **Spotify / Spotify News:** the brand isn't in the dev brand typeahead under the Spotify account. A short query, "Spotify Ne", returns only 8 results and none is Spotify News. I didn't substitute a brand, per Rule 1.
- **Sony Pictures / Sony Pictures Television:** this is the second pair in the same Thursday row, so I ran it. Account, brand, the Impressions data set and TikTok-only all applied. The post grid then showed "This table failed to load". Clicking Reload and then one full page reload both left it stuck for about 5 minutes. The dev data API returned HTTP 500 on `/content`, and several `dsp-api.lfmdev.in` calls failed with CORS/`ERR_FAILED`.

The page did show an aggregate row for the Sony brand before the hang (Impressions sum 24,240, Organic and Paid "–"). That isn't per-post data, so it doesn't count toward either assertion.

The report is at `results/2026-10-29/QA-29278-report.md`, with screenshots under `.playwright-out/QA-29278/`. It also notes that the case file's Notes line ("Thu Spotify/Conde Nast") disagrees with the Description table, and I followed the table.

A re-run is worth doing once dev `/content` recovers, and someone should confirm where Spotify News lives on dev.
